During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] began a '''campaign''' to uncover the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agents known as the [[Children of the Emperor]] who had unknowingly infiltrated the Republic and other organizations.
